changelog: Initial table from PLAN.md section 7.4. Weights are a first guess pending review against real projects.

rules.title: Quarterly report not filed
rules.detail: A quarterly report was not filed by its deadline.

rules.title: Notice for a missed report
rules.detail: A notice was issued for a missed quarterly report.

rules.title: Quarterly report filed late
rules.detail: A quarterly report was filed after its deadline.

rules.title: Completion date moved
rules.detail: The completion date moved 1 to 6 months later than first filed.

rules.title: Completion date moved
rules.detail: The completion date moved 7 to 12 months later than first filed.

rules.title: Completion date moved
rules.detail: The completion date moved 13 to 24 months later than first filed.

rules.title: Completion date moved
rules.detail: The completion date moved more than 24 months later than first filed.

rules.title: Extension granted
rules.detail: An extension of the registration was granted.

rules.title: Complaints filed
rules.detail: 1 to 2 complaints were filed against the project in the last 24 months.

rules.title: Complaints filed
rules.detail: 3 to 5 complaints were filed against the project in the last 24 months.

rules.title: Complaints filed
rules.detail: 6 or more complaints were filed against the project in the last 24 months.

rules.title: Order issued
rules.detail: An order was issued against the project or its promoter in the last 24 months.

rules.title: No progress reported
rules.detail: Reported percent complete did not rise between the last two filed reports.

rules.title: Registration lapsed
rules.detail: The registration validity passed with no extension on file.
